description: This file implements the MotionService class, providing asynchronous methods to fetch motion activity and pedometer data using CoreMotion APIs. It handles permission checks, data querying, and data formatting for motion-related metrics.

classes.name: MotionService
classes.description: A service class providing methods to retrieve motion activities and pedometer data asynchronously.

methods.name: activities
methods.description: Fetches motion activity data within a specified time range and limits the number of entries returned.

methods.name: pedometer
methods.description: Retrieves pedometer data such as steps, distance, and floors ascended/descended within a specified time range.

methods.name: resolveRange
methods.description: Converts ISO8601 string parameters into start and end Date objects, defaulting to today start and current date if not provided.

methods.name: confidenceString
methods.description: Converts CMMotionActivityConfidence enum values to corresponding string representations.
